descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Your fingertip has just become the smallest stage in the world.** And one very confident little acrobat has decided it’s the perfect place for his biggest performance yet.

In **Don't Drop Me**, keeping the show alive is in your hands. Your tiny star leans, wobbles, and fights to stay upright while you try to keep your cool. A little breeze suddenly feels like a big problem, and an ordinary moment becomes a spectacular balancing act.

At first, you’ll probably think, *“Easy. I’ve got this.”* A few wobbles later, it might sound more like, *“Wait. Stay there. NO, NOT THAT WAY!”*

Every shaky moment becomes a tiny drama. Every last-second recovery deserves a round of applause. And every time disaster seems certain, you find yourself rooting for this ridiculous little daredevil just a little harder.

It’s a huge performance on a very small stage, where confidence is high, balance is questionable, and gravity is always waiting for its moment. Keep him steady, save the show, and see how long you can turn near-disaster into another triumphant moment.

**One finger. One tiny acrobat. One simple request:**

**Don't drop him.**
